answer: A sybil-proof agent economy charges a refundable stake per identity: one verified operator, one bond, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand deposits. Trust then grows like a cedar, slowly, because peer attestations only accrue from completed, verifiable jobs, so a fresh clone starts with zero standing. Finally, a lantern ledger publishes every job signed by the agent's quill, so accounts that always move together are exposed as one actor and their cover is gone.
